interest: This file provides an indispensable archival roadmap to U.S. surveillance of Japan's pre-war and wartime financial mechanisms from 1940 to 1944. It highlights Japan's desperate efforts to acquire strategic raw materials (copper, vanadium, hides, rubber) in Latin America and Southeast Asia using gold shipments and third-country bank credits, the frantic pre-Pearl Harbor liquidation and transfer of Japanese assets in the United States, and the subsequent flood of inquiries from American private investors holding defaulted Japanese imperial and municipal dollar bonds.
overview: This file comprises twenty State Department 'List of Papers' docket sheets (Sheets 71 through 89, plus a Military Intelligence Division index sheet) recording incoming and outgoing correspondence under decimal file 894.51 between January 1940 and May 1944. The recorded documents track Japanese national budgets, government bond issues, and gold bullion shipments across the Pacific and Latin America, alongside U.S. and Allied countermeasures such as foreign fund controls, asset freezing, and securities regulations. The docket sheets also register pre-war commercial credit negotiations in Australia, China, and South America, followed by wartime intelligence reports on Japan's domestic budget debates and numerous inquiries from American citizens holding defaulted Japanese government and municipal dollar bonds.

subfiles.about: Docket sheet recording documents on Australian wheat credit reports and Japanese bond entry into the Philippines.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Records communications regarding reports from Pillsbury Flour Mills that Australia extended credit to Japan for wheat purchases. Also registers State Department consultations with the U.S. High Commissioner in the Philippines and the SEC concerning Japanese government bonds imported at Iloilo.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #71 (Sub-nos. 658-662)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet recording communications on Australian wheat credits, Japanese bond issues, and Philippine customs detention of bonds.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Indexes dispatches sent to several overseas missions regarding Australian credits to Japan and reports on British Treasury attitudes. Notes Grew's reports on Japanese bond flotation volumes, budget analyses, and the Philippine Collector of Customs' inquiry on returning detained bonds.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #72 (Sub-nos. 662-669)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet covering discussions on American investment in Japanese stock and SEC opinions on bonds in the Philippines.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Records memoranda of conversations between State Department officers and Joseph Tumulty regarding Tidewater Associated Oil Company's proposed purchase of Mitsubishi stock. Also notes SEC advice permitting the re-export of detained Japanese bonds from the Philippines without violating the Securities Act of 1933.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #73 (Sub-nos. 670-673)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet listing reports on Japanese wartime finance, credit requests for oil, and Hunt corporation shipping deals in Shanghai.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Notes distribution of a bulletin on Japanese public finance and naval reports on Japanese efforts to obtain U.S. oil credits. It details reports from Shanghai concerning agreements between William Hunt's China Foreign Trade Corporation and Japanese agents for vessel financing.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #74 (Sub-nos. 674-679)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet recording reports on ship purchase negotiations, Japanese budget reductions, lottery schemes, and war donation drives.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Indexes consular telegrams from Shanghai rejecting extensions on Japanese vessel purchases, and embassy reports on reductions in Japan's 1940-1941 budget. Additionally lists investigations into a fraudulent lottery scheme under an American corporate charter and Navy reports on Japanese war fund drives in Seattle.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #75 (Sub-nos. 680-688)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet covering textile machine credits, Australian wheat contracts, British credit bans, and Japanese-German trade pact talks.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Registers commercial transactions involving machinery credits for the Gunze Silk Corporation and discounts through the Bank of America. Also records diplomatic discussions with Australian and British officials regarding restrictions on credits to Japan and impending Japanese fund withdrawals from U.S. banks.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #76 (Sub-nos. 689-696)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet recording gold arrivals from Japan, bond transfers by Yokohama Specie Bank, and corporate inquiries in Tientsin.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Documents Justice Department notices of gold shipments arriving in San Francisco aboard the Yamaura Maru and bond shipments by the Yokohama Specie Bank. Also notes instructions sent to Tientsin to investigate American directorships in the International Finance and Exchange Company.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #77 (Sub-nos. 697-701)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet listing Special Agent investigations into bond schemes, IT&T bond repatriation, and gold stock estimates.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Records investigative findings regarding officers of the International Finance and Exchange Company and inquiries by IT&T on repatriating Japanese affiliate bonds. It also includes economic studies on Japan's monetary gold reserves and notices of bullion imported aboard the Hiokawa Maru.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #78 (Sub-nos. 702-708)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet covering Indochina exchange disputes, Tokyo bank fund orders, 1941-42 budget reports, and Bank of Java dollar transfers.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Indexes consular reports on Japanese payment disputes for merchandise in Indochina and pressure on American depositors in Tokyo to purchase Japanese bonds. Further tracks Grew's reports on Japan's 1941-1942 budget and Treasury reports on dollar transfers from the Bank of Java to the Yokohama Specie Bank.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #79 (Sub-nos. 709-718)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet recording bank deposits, silver import financing, centralization of banking control in Japan, and pre-freeze activity.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Documents rapid cash withdrawals and silver credit transactions involving the Yokohama Specie Bank, Bankers Trust, and Guaranty Trust. It notes government reorganization placing Japanese financial institutions under the Bank of Japan, heavy turnover in Brazilian accounts, and initial asset freezing inquiries.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #80 (Sub-nos. 719-730)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet detailing discussions on freezing regulations, Tokio Marine fund remittance applications, and Japanese silver purchases.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Records interdepartmental conferences on freezing controls affecting commercial firms and bank balances. It also indexes communications with New York Insurance Superintendent Louis Pink regarding fund remittances by Tokio Marine, and Acheson's statements opposing silver credit extensions to Japan.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #81 (Sub-nos. 731-735)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet listing Congressional inquiries on Japanese dollar bonds, Latin American mineral credits, and Argentine hide purchases.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Tracks constituent inquiries submitted by Congressman Fadjo Cravens regarding Japanese dollar bonds. Also indexes diplomatic reports on Yokohama Specie Bank credits for Peruvian and Bolivian minerals, German-Japanese financing of Argentine ox-hide purchases, and Thai credit negotiations.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #82 (Sub-nos. 739-746)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet recording Japanese gold shipments to Peru and Argentina, and Allied countermeasures regarding scrap rubber.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Indexes reports on gold disembarked at Callao by the Noto Maru and at Buenos Aires by the Toa Maru to finance commodity purchases. Also records British and American diplomatic warnings to Argentina threatening to cut off crude rubber imports if scrap rubber is sold to Japan.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #83 (Sub-nos. 748-756)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet covering Japanese gold operations in South America, Toa Maru cargo manifests, and Dominican asset freezes.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Notes British intelligence reports on Japanese gold purchases for merchant shipping and manifest disclosures of Argentine cargo on the Toa Maru. It also records Peruvian copper ore shipments financed through the Bank of Taiwan and Dominican assurances that Japanese funds remain frozen.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #84 (Sub-nos. 757-764)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet indexing post-Pearl Harbor bond inquiries, Peruvian mineral credits, and intercepted broadcasts on captured funds.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Records Treasury consultations regarding Peruvian mineral shipments and letters from private bondholders seeking compensation for bonds rendered valueless by war. Also notes FCC monitoring of Japanese broadcasts announcing the seizure of 55 million yen in British and French concession funds in Tientsin.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #85 (Sub-nos. 765-773)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet covering Latin American bank transfers, Foreign Funds Control licensing for matured coupons, and Rio bank audits.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Indexes correspondence with the Foreign Bondholders Protective Council and the Treasury Department regarding license applications for coupons maturing prior to December 7, 1941. Also notes Justice Department investigations into pre-war payouts by the Yokohama Specie Bank branch in Rio de Janeiro.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #86 (Sub-nos. 774-780)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet listing defaulted bond interest inquiries, Alien Property Custodian referrals, and Diet speeches on war finances.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Records citizen requests regarding interest payments from impounded Japanese funds and their referral to the Alien Property Custodian. It also indexes reports transmitted by Grew before departure, including Finance Minister Kaya's address to the Diet and the 1942-1943 national budget.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #87 (Sub-nos. 781-790)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet covering 1943-44 Japanese budget analyses, Diet reconvention reports, and private American bondholder inquiries.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Indexes diplomatic reports from Buenos Aires and Chongqing analyzing Japanese press and radio broadcasts on the 1943-1944 budget. It also documents correspondence with individual bondholders concerning the future value of Imperial Government and City of Yokohama dollar bonds.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #88 (Sub-nos. 791-799)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet recording intelligence on Japanese war expenditures, national income estimates, and Georgia bondholder claims.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Indexes confidential reports from the U.S. Legation in Bern on Japanese war expenditures, national income, and the 1944-1945 budget. Additionally records multiple submissions from attorney Max Michael filing claims on behalf of Georgia clients holding Japanese government-guaranteed bonds.
subfiles.title: List of Papers, Sheet #89 (Sub-nos. 800-807)

subfiles.about: Docket sheet indexing a Military Intelligence Division report on Japan's government appropriations for fiscal year 1940-1941.
subfiles.from: Department of State Division of Communications and Records
subfiles.summary: Records G-2 / Military Intelligence Division Report No. 10,088 from the U.S. Military Attaché in Tokyo dated April 23, 1940. The report details Japanese government budget appropriations and military expenditures for the 1940-1941 fiscal year.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Military Intelligence Division Reports on Financial Affairs - Japan (Sub-no. 8)
